editorial:
Imagine being a boss everyone hated, then surviving a nightmare at work only to find your mind is still a mess. That is where you start with this story. You follow a woman who heads to a quiet, hidden retreat to get her life back together. At first, it feels like a peaceful break, but the vibe quickly shifts. You will feel the tension grow as weird things start happening around the house. It makes you wonder if she is just losing it or if there is actually something scary hiding in the dark corners of the woods.

The acting is great and really sells the fear, though the middle part of the movie slows down a bit. However, the twists at the end make the wait worth it. If you love movies that mess with your head, you need to see this.
endingExplained: You find out that the retreat was actually a trap. The therapist was not trying to heal her, but was using her guilt to feed a monster that lives in the basement. In the final scene, the main character realizes the monster is a reflection of her own past cruelty. She manages to kill the creature by finally forgiving herself, which destroys the monster and lets her escape the woods alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty horror movies and mysteries.
